summary: Cushman & Wakefield Ltd. filed an 8-K to disclose an amendment (the Amendment) to its existing Credit Agreement, executed on June 12, 2026, by its subsidiaries Cushman Wakefield U.S. Borrower, LLC and DTZ UK Guarantor Limited, with JPMorgan Chase Bank as administrative agent. The amendment reprices approximately $848 million of senior secured term loans (2026-1 Term Loans), extends their maturity to 2033, and upsizes the facility by about $353 million. Interest is SOFR plus 2.25% or Base Rate plus 1.25%; a 1% soft call premium applies for six months. The remaining $840 million 2025-3 Term Loans are unchanged. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation.
